# Shri Ganesh Infotech

CCTV surveillance, security systems, biometric attendance, access control and networking solutions company based in Chandrapur, Maharashtra, India. Tagline: "Your Trusted Security Partner in Chandrapur". 5+ years of experience with 1,000+ installations. Deals in CP PLUS, DAICHI and other genuine compatible security brands.

## Pages
- Home: overview of security solutions, experience stats, featured services and contact options.
- About Us: company introduction, experience, mission and why customers choose them.
- Services: twelve services — CCTV camera installation, solar CCTV, IP camera solutions, wireless CCTV, biometric attendance, video door phone, access control, networking, DVR/NVR installation, CCTV repair and maintenance, security system upgrades, annual maintenance contracts. Each service has its own detail page.
- Products: catalogue of CCTV cameras, recording systems, security accessories, biometric and access control products, with WhatsApp enquiry on every product.
- Industries: security solutions for homes, shops, offices, schools, hospitals, factories, warehouses, hotels, commercial buildings and construction sites.
- AMC: annual maintenance contract coverage and assistance request.
- Contact: address, phone, WhatsApp, business hours, Google Maps location and enquiry form that opens WhatsApp.
